name: codelink
description: Turn your VS Code workspace into a secure local MCP server for external AI agents.

codelink.server.enabled.description: Start the CodeLink MCP server automatically when the workspace opens. The server is stopped by default and must be started explicitly.

codelink.server.host.description: Network interface the MCP server binds to. Must remain 127.0.0.1 unless remote access is explicitly enabled.

codelink.server.port.description: TCP port the MCP server listens on.

codelink.server.transport.description: MCP network transport. Only Streamable HTTP is currently supported.

enumDescriptions: Read-only access: workspace, search, editor read, diagnostics, git read.
Adds editor write and file write on top of readonly (default).
Adds file delete, terminal, and git write. Requires explicit confirmation to activate.
Use the individual codelink.security.allow* settings instead of a preset.
codelink.security.profile.description: Security profile controlling which tool permissions are granted.

codelink.security.requireAuth.description: Require authentication (OAuth 2.0 or bearer token). When false, clients can connect freely with No Auth.

codelink.security.allowFileWrite.description: Only used when codelink.security.profile is "custom". Allow tools to write files in the workspace.

codelink.security.allowFileDelete.description: Only used when codelink.security.profile is "custom". Allow tools to delete files in the workspace.

codelink.security.allowEditorWrite.description: Only used when codelink.security.profile is "custom". Allow tools to modify open editor documents.

codelink.security.allowTerminal.description: Only used when codelink.security.profile is "custom". Allow tools to create and run terminal processes.

codelink.security.allowGitWrite.description: Only used when codelink.security.profile is "custom". Allow tools to perform Git write operations.

codelink.remote.enabled.description: Allow the MCP server to bind to a non-loopback host and accept authenticated remote connections. Disabled by default.

codelink.security.allowSecretFileAccess.description: Allow tools to read files that look like secrets (.env, private keys, credential files). Disabled by default; this is defense-in-depth, not a complete secret scanner.

codelink.files.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns excluded from workspace listing, search, and file access by default.

codelink.files.maxReadBytes.description: Maximum number of bytes a single file_read/editor_read call may return.

codelink.files.maxWriteBytes.description: Maximum number of bytes a single file_write call may accept.

codelink.search.maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches returned by a single search request.

codelink.search.maxFileSize.description: Files larger than this are skipped during search.

codelink.search.timeoutMs.description: Maximum time a single search request may run before it is cancelled.

codelink.terminal.timeoutMs.description: Maximum time a terminal_run command may execute before being killed.

codelink.terminal.maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum captured output size per terminal process.

codelink.rateLimit.requestsPerMinute.description: Maximum MCP requests accepted per minute per client, enforced when remote access is enabled.

codelink.rateLimit.maxConcurrentRequests.description: Maximum number of tool calls executed concurrently.

codelink.logging.level.description: Verbosity of the CodeLink output channel.

codelink.tunnel.cloudflaredPath.description: Path to the cloudflared executable. Leave empty to search the system PATH.

scripts.test:vscode: npm run build && npm run build:test && node ./out-test/runExtensionTests.js
